_comment: Golden fixture for load_discovered_servers (crates/shed-broker/src/discovery.rs) — input ~/.shed/config.yaml text -> expected []ServerTarget. Recorded while the Go daemon still read it; its one reader now is the Rust test golden_load_discovered_servers in crates/shed-broker/src/discovery.rs. Pins the load-bearing divergences from shed-core::ShedConfig: ssh_port defaults to 0 (NOT 22) when omitted, and empty-host entries are skipped. Targets are sorted by name. auth_mode is carried VERBATIM from the entry and is NOT defaulted: "" (never recorded, legacy entry) and "token" (recorded) stay distinguishable, because only the former means "this client has never been told". user (the named user the shed CLI recorded) is carried verbatim (an unquoted scalar is read as its text, as Go's reader reads it: true is the user name "true"); absent or null is "" (no user held); a list or a map is "!not-a-string" (no valid user name, so the entry fails closed instead of reading as no user). Both members are required on every expected entry.

vectors.name: ssh_port default 0, empty-host skipped, api_url vs http fallback, auth_mode carried, sorted
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  https-with-ssh:
    api_url: https://a.example:8443
    host: a.example
    ssh_port: 2222
    auth_mode: mtls
  https-no-ssh:
    api_url: https://b.example:8443
    host: b.example
    auth_mode: token
  plain:
    host: c.example
    http_port: 9000
  empty-host:
    ssh_port: 2222

vectors.name: credentials_token + raw tls_cert_fingerprint carried; ssh_port parsed; default http_port 8080
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  s:
    host: s.example
    ssh_port: 8022
    credentials_token: tok-abc
    tls_cert_fingerprint: sha256:AABBcc

vectors.name: auth_mode is verbatim: an unrecognized value is neither normalized nor rejected
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  weird:
    api_url: https://w.example:8443
    host: w.example
    ssh_port: 2222
    auth_mode: MTLS

vectors.name: user is carried verbatim per entry; absent is empty
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  held:
    api_url: https://h.example:8443
    host: h.example
    ssh_port: 2222
    auth_mode: mtls
    user: pat
  unheld:
    api_url: https://u.example:8443
    host: u.example
    ssh_port: 2222
    auth_mode: mtls

vectors.name: a user that is not a plain string fails closed as !not-a-string, never empty; null is empty; a number is a scalar kept verbatim
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  blockmap:
    host: bm.example
    user:
      name: pat
  flowlist:
    host: fl.example
    user: [pat]
  flowmap:
    host: fm.example
    user: {}
  list:
    host: l.example
    user:
    - pat
  null:
    host: n.example
    user:
  number:
    host: num.example
    user: 5

vectors.name: an unquoted true is read as its text, as Go's reader reads it: the user name true, the same as the quoted value
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  quoted:
    host: q.example
    user: "true"
  unquoted:
    host: u.example
    user: true
